# deckcraft

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components/deckcraft; do not edit. -->

DeckCraft, a presentation and slide show application, from the official DEB that each GitHub release of [storytold/deckcraft](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft) carries, kept up to date through the local APT bridge with plain `apt update && apt upgrade`.

The component lives in [`modules/components/deckcraft`](../../modules/components/deckcraft/):

- [README.md](../../modules/components/deckcraft/README.md): what it installs, its options and its settings.
- [maintenance.md](../../modules/components/deckcraft/maintenance.md): its pins and how `dotsteward-update` refreshes them.
- [default.nix](../../modules/components/deckcraft/default.nix): the Home Manager module that fills the component contract.
- [seed.json](../../modules/components/deckcraft/seed.json): the flake inputs and lock entries an instance starts with when it enables the component.

See the [catalog](../catalog.md) for the other components.
